reading.title: At the Sandwich Counter
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述原文，而是换到点餐柜台的真实听力场景：学生努力说清楚，却遇到很快的英语回应，重点练习 not only...but...as well / neither...nor... 和礼貌请求重复。
word_bank: Could you say that again, please?
passage: Nina was visiting Manchester with her class. At lunchtime, she stood at a sandwich counter and tried to order in English. She not only said the words carefully, but pointed to the menu as well. The assistant, however, spoke very fast. He spoke neither slowly nor clearly. Nina did not pretend to understand. She smiled and said, "I am a foreigner. Could you say that again, please?" The assistant repeated the question several times and showed her the two choices: brown bread or white bread. At last, Nina ordered lunch by herself. She realized real English was not only grammar in a book, but listening in a noisy room as well.

questions.question: Where did Nina try to order lunch?
options: At a quiet hotel in London.
At a sandwich counter in Manchester.
At a railway information desk.
At a classroom door.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 Nina stood at a sandwich counter and tried to order in English。

questions.question: How did Nina try to make her order clear?
options: She wrote everything in Chinese.
She only pointed and said nothing.
She said the words carefully and pointed to the menu as well.
She asked her teacher to order for her.
questions.explanation_zh: 这里用了 not only...but...as well：她不但认真说，也指着菜单。

questions.question: Why was the assistant hard for Nina to understand?
options: He spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
He did not speak English at all.
He refused to show the menu.
He only talked to Nina's teacher.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文写道：He spoke neither slowly nor clearly。

questions.question: What did Nina ask the assistant to do?
options: To give her a free lunch.
To call her English teacher.
To close the noisy counter.
To say the question again.
questions.explanation_zh: 她礼貌地说：Could you say that again, please?

questions.question: What did Nina realize at the end?
options: Real English can include listening in a noisy room, not only grammar in a book.
She should never order lunch in English again.
Assistants must always speak like teachers.
Brown bread is easier to understand than white bread.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾说 real English was not only grammar in a book, but listening in a noisy room as well。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓四个真正值得背的结构：问路、强调自己已经努力表达、描述听力困难，以及礼貌地请求对方重复。

patterns.title: did not know the way to ...
patterns.source: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 the way to... 表示“去某地的路”，后面自然接 so I asked... 说明你怎么求助。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你在车站、机场或校园里不知道去某个地方的路，所以向工作人员或同学求助。
must_include: did not know the way to
patterns.sample: I did not know the way to the library, so I asked a student.
patterns.tip_zh: the way to 后面接地点，比只说 where is... 更有叙事感。

patterns.title: not only... but... as well
patterns.source: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个结构把两个优点放在一起，表示“我已经很努力了”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你不但说得认真，而且也说得清楚、礼貌或慢一些。
patterns.sample: I not only spoke very politely, but very slowly as well.
patterns.tip_zh: A 和 B 最好是同一类动作或特点，比如 carefully / clearly / politely / slowly。

patterns.title: neither... nor...
patterns.source: He answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
patterns.focus_zh: neither... nor... 一次否定两个方面，很适合描述“听不懂”的原因。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：对方回答了你，但说得既不慢也不清楚，或者信息既不短也不简单。
patterns.sample: The guide answered me, but she spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
patterns.tip_zh: neither 后面和 nor 后面要放并列成分，比如两个副词 slowly / clearly。

patterns.title: Could you say that again, please?
patterns.source: I am a foreigner. Could you say that again, please?
patterns.focus_zh: 真实交流中，比硬撑更重要的是礼貌地请求重复或放慢速度。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：你是外国人或游客，请对方再说一遍，或者说慢一点。
patterns.sample: I am a foreigner. Could you speak more slowly, please?
patterns.tip_zh: Could you...? 加 please 很适合旅行、车站、酒店前台等礼貌求助场景。
